name: Tungnath & Chopta
shortDescription: Meadows at Chopta and the walk toward Tungnath, with the coach starting in Greater Noida.
introduction: Groups that want Chopta usually leave Greater Noida before dawn, break once on the highway, and reach the meadows with enough light for a short walk. Arohan Travels prices that driving day — and the return — around your nights. The temple trail and where you sleep stay your call.
highlights: Road access toward the Tungnath walk
Works for a mid-size family or friends' group
suggestedDuration: Many groups keep 2–4 nights. Tell us if you want a tighter weekend.
roadTravelNotes: The last stretch is a hill road, so we plan for daylight and a real rest stop. Say if elders are on board and we will not pack the driving day.
coverAlt: Chopta meadows on the road Arohan groups take toward Tungnath

name: Nainital
shortDescription: A lake-town weekend that starts with a pickup in Greater Noida, Noida or Ghaziabad.
introduction: Nainital is the trip families book when they want Naini Lake and one or two nights in the hills. We collect the group from Greater Noida, Ghaziabad or Delhi and quote only the coach. Mall Road, viewpoints and a side trip to Bhimtal are yours to order.
highlights: Nearby lakes if you add a day
Room for a family with elders
suggestedDuration: A Friday departure and a Sunday return is the usual ask.
roadTravelNotes: The climb after Kathgodam is winding. A Greater Noida start around dawn keeps the first day comfortable.
coverAlt: Naini Lake, a frequent weekend run from Arohan's Greater Noida desk

name: Mussoorie
shortDescription: A short hill run to Mussoorie, with Mall Road and viewpoints on your list.
introduction: Mussoorie is close enough for a long weekend from our side of NCR. Tell us whether Dehradun is a stop on the way, and Arohan will price a Force Urbania or the larger Traveller from Greater Noida.
highlights: Kempty side if you want it
suggestedDuration: Two nights cover Mall Road without a rushed return.
roadTravelNotes: Weekend traffic stacks up near the popular stops. A slightly earlier Greater Noida departure avoids the worst of it.
coverAlt: Mussoorie ridge, within a long weekend of Greater Noida

name: Kedarnath
shortDescription: Coach support up to the open roadhead for a Kedarnath yatra group.
introduction: Arohan does not trek the final stretch to Kedarnath. We arrange the coach from Greater Noida or Delhi NCR to the practical roadhead for that season, and we say so if weather or local rules shorten the drive.
highlights: Pace set for elders if you tell us
recommendedMonths: Typically May–October (official yatra season varies yearly)
suggestedDuration: Most parties keep 3–5 days once rest stops are included.
roadTravelNotes: Open roads change with the season. Send dates early so the fare matches a route that is actually driveable.
coverAlt: Kedarnath region, reached by road as far as the season allows

name: Haridwar & Rishikesh
shortDescription: Ghats and aarti timing, as a day run or an overnight from Greater Noida.
introduction: Haridwar and Rishikesh are the trips people book when they want the Ganga without a long mountain day. Share the aarti you care about and the headcount, and we will quote a door pickup from Ghaziabad, Noida or Delhi.
recommendedMonths: October–March for cooler weather; year-round for pilgrimages
suggestedDuration: One long day, or two if you want both towns without hurry.
roadTravelNotes: The highway from Greater Noida is straightforward. Festival evenings need extra time near the ghats, so we build that into the plan.
coverAlt: Ganga riverfront on the Haridwar and Rishikesh run

name: Manali
shortDescription: A multi-day Himachal run with one coach for the whole valley.
introduction: Manali needs honest driving days, not a packed brochure. Arohan quotes Force Urbania or Traveller travel from Greater Noida around your dates and luggage, and leaves hotels off the bill.
highlights: Valley time, not just the drive
Solang if the group wants it
Mall Road without a fixed tour
One vehicle for the whole party
suggestedDuration: Four to six days is realistic once the highway is counted.
roadTravelNotes: This is a long highway plus a hill finish. Overnight or pre-dawn starts from Greater Noida are the comfortable options.
coverAlt: Manali valley on a multi-day coach run from Greater Noida

name: Shimla
shortDescription: The Ridge and Mall Road, with the coach arranged from Greater Noida.
introduction: Shimla weekends fill quickly. Arohan prices the vehicle from Greater Noida or Noida, and you tell us if Kufri or Chail should sit on the same loop.
suggestedDuration: Three to five days if you want the town without a same-day turnaround.
roadTravelNotes: Holiday weekends crawl near Shimla. Share a flexible arrival window and the Greater Noida departure is easier to hold.
coverAlt: Shimla town, a Himachal run quoted from Greater Noida

name: Jaipur
shortDescription: Forts and bazaars on a highway day or a two-night Pink City halt.
introduction: Jaipur is mostly open highway from our side of NCR. We time a Greater Noida departure so the group reaches the forts with daylight left, and we quote the coach separately from monument tickets.
suggestedDuration: One long day, or up to three if the group wants the city slowly.
roadTravelNotes: The drive from Greater Noida is mostly highway. An early start is what leaves time for Amer the same day.
coverAlt: Jaipur forts, a highway day from Greater Noida

name: Jammu & Kashmir
shortDescription: Staged valley travel once you name the cities and the season.
introduction: Jammu & Kashmir only works as a coach plan when the city list is clear. Send Srinagar, Gulmarg, Pahalgam, Jammu — or the mix you want — and Arohan will quote the driving days from Greater Noida.
recommendedMonths: April–October for many valley routes (confirm seasonally)
suggestedDuration: Often five to eight days, depending on how many valleys you add.
roadTravelNotes: These are long stages. We split them so the group is not asked to sit through an unsafe day, and we revisit the plan if the weather turns.
coverAlt: A Kashmir valley stage on a longer Arohan coach plan

name: Ayodhya
shortDescription: A pilgrimage run into Uttar Pradesh, timed around your darshan window.
introduction: Ayodhya groups usually want a clear departure from Greater Noida and extra time if a festival is on. Arohan arranges the vehicle and the driving plan. Darshan arrangements stay with you.
suggestedDuration: One to three days, longer if Lucknow is on the same loop.
roadTravelNotes: Festival dates crowd the approach roads. Book the travel window early and we will pad the arrival.
coverAlt: Ayodhya, a pilgrimage drive from Greater Noida

name: Mathura & Vrindavan
shortDescription: Temple circuits in Mathura and Vrindavan, often finished the same day.
introduction: Mathura and Vrindavan sit close enough for a dawn start from Greater Noida and an evening return. Tell us which temples matter and whether elders are travelling, and we will match a Traveller or an Urbania.
highlights: Overnight if the list is long
Easier boarding if you ask for it
suggestedDuration: Most groups finish in one or two days.
roadTravelNotes: The run from Greater Noida is short by our standards. Festival days still need a buffer near the temples.
coverAlt: Temples in Mathura and Vrindavan, a short run from NCR

name: Jim Corbett
shortDescription: A nature weekend, with the coach dropped at your Corbett gate or lodge.
introduction: Jim Corbett trips go wrong when the lodge and the gate are vague. Share the stay area and Arohan will quote a Greater Noida pickup timed for daylight at the forest edge.
highlights: Drop at your gate or lodge
Nature trip, not a safari package
Early start if you want arrival light
recommendedMonths: November–June (park zones and activities vary by season)
suggestedDuration: Two or three days is the request we hear most.
roadTravelNotes: Tell us the gate and the lodge before we quote. A pre-dawn leave from Greater Noida is what protects the first afternoon.
coverAlt: Forest near Jim Corbett, a weekend coach run from Greater Noida
